# Full transitive closure for the pytest validation suite — EXACT pins with
# sha256 hashes of every release artifact, consumable with:
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-test.txt
#
# The CI job installs it THIS way: unpinned/floating validator tooling means a
# hostile (or merely broken) upstream release is executed by our own trust-
# validating CI (review phlix-plugins__seceng M-07). Bump deliberately:
# resolve a new closure locally, re-run the suite, refresh both pins + hashes.
# Regenerate hashes: query https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json .urls[].
# [.digests.sha256, .filename] (this file's shape is that output, hand-ordered).
